caption: The drawing depicts a wooden piece of furniture resembling a writing desk or cupboard with a rectangular upper compartment that appears to have a hinged lid, as suggested by visible brass-colored metal hinges and a keyhole. The wood is rendered in shades of brown with detailed grain patterns, and the structure sits on four turned legs with carved details. There are no other objects or background elements, and the desk is centered on a cream or off-white plain background. In the bottom right corner, there is a small handwritten signature reading "Henry Meyers."
title: Writing Desk
